method: 750 rows over 750 distinct locations, cut 2026-09-09 at seed 20260909 as three balanced sheets of ~250 that each carry the same mix of all four blocks, over the candidate pool of ledger stamp 0b3fdcd01d6bd6f9 (308,885 candidates, 42,300 clearing their own mode's bar over 12,212 places) and the tentative record 20260909T215815Z. FOUR BLOCKS. (1) 300 TOP BAND: candidates reading p_fine(>=4) >= 0.85 on the gallery-grade head auc_ge4_more_seed2, drawn from 6,245 such rows - head-selected, and the block is a false-positive hunt. (2) 200 NEAR BAR: 0.40 <= p_fine(>=4) <= 0.65 on the same column, drawn from 3,724 - head-selected. (3) 150 FLOOR-BOUGHT THIN CELLS: seats of record 20260909T215815Z carrying a cell_floor: stamp, taking all 83 admissible seats the K=3 floor bought for the six cells that landed exactly on its floor of 20 (dark_vivid_lime, dark_muted_lime, dark_vivid_cyan, light_vivid_cyan, light_vivid_azure, light_muted_blue) - 93 exist and 10 were excluded - then 44 topped up from the other 194 floor-stamped seats in modes outside the cap and 23 from inside it. (4) 100 LOW ANCHORS: an unconditioned draw over the two coarse corpora's resolved score-3 rows, restricted to the 13 accepted modes; no model score enters that draw. MODE BALANCE: blocks 1, 2 and 4 are stratified toward even coverage across the 13 accepted modes with tia, threads and stripe each capped at 4% of the block, water-filled so a mode short of its target gives the rest back; block 3's mode mix is the colour floor's own and is deliberately not capped, because capping the seats the floor bought would change what that block measures. Colour cells are filled greedily toward evenness inside every block. EXCLUSIONS throughout: one row per location, and no render already in this store - 64 rows dropped as already graded and 119 as a second row at a location already taken. REALIZED over the 750: all 48 chromatic cells and all 13 accepted modes present; tia 72, stripe 57, threads 31, 21.3% between them against 34.4% of the clearing pool and 50.8% of this store's standing 1,000 rows; kinds 650 strange / 100 smooth; 153 rows render through the candidate's own re-baked colormap. THE PAGE IS A CORRECTION PAGE: 650 of the 750 carry the fine head's own decode of their candidate at the ledger's 640x360 geometry as a prefilled suggestion and the page is ordered good to bad by that head's expected grade; block 4's 100 carry no suggestion, because the fine head has no output for a row that never cleared the pool bar, and they sit after every row it could read.
why: NEVER EVAL-ELIGIBLE, and the gallery_grade store refuses a batch that claims otherwise. Three of the four blocks are conditioned draws - two on this store's own head and one on the seats a colour floor bought - so no rate read off these 750 is a rate about the world and none of them may ever be held out. THE PAGE IS PREFILLED AND SCORE-ORDERED, which is why `anchored` is true: it measures DOWNWARD disagreement only, so this batch's correction rate is a ceiling on the head's error and not its report card, and the top band is judge-selected, so near-all-downward corrections are what that selection produces rather than a finding about the head. Blocks 1-3 carry the fine head's decode read at the ledger's 640x360 candidate geometry and not on the 1280x720 picture the page serves; block 4 carries no prefill at all. `refusal` is null on every row of this batch, seated or not, because this leg ran no counterfactual replay of the record's solve - unlike n1000_0906_*, where it means the rule that refused the row.

method: 250 rows over 250 distinct locations, cut 2026-09-10 from the tentative record 20260910T025205Z (solve tentative_n1000_20260910T025205Z, n=1000, fine bar 0.184, fine head corrected_auc_ge4_more_seed1). ONE BLOCK, and the selection is a census rather than a sample: of the record's 1,000 seats, 205 already carry a verdict in this store and 795 do not; the 795 were sorted by p_fine(>=4) ASCENDING, ties by candidate key, and the first 250 taken. Nothing was dropped on the way - no seat failed the one-row-per-location rule, none resolved to a render this store already holds under another candidate key, and every ledger row named its whole recipe - so the sheet is exactly the 250 lowest-p_fine ungraded seats and the walk stopped at the 250th. p_fine spans 0.191093 to 0.704099, the low end being the gallery's own floor: 0.184 is the bar the pool was narrowed at. REALIZED over the 250: all 13 accepted modes present, 45 of the 48 chromatic cells and all 13 hue families; tia 76, smooth 64, stripe 30; kinds 188 strange / 62 smooth; 89 rows render through the candidate's own re-baked colormap. By the leg that seated them, 163 came from the general pool, 58 from a mode floor, 28 from a cell floor and 1 from a swap - the mode floors are over-represented against their 178 of 1,000, which is what a draw off the bottom of the fine column finds. THE PAGE IS A CORRECTION PAGE: every one of the 250 carries the fine head's own decode of its candidate at the ledger's 640x360 geometry as a prefilled suggestion (217 read 4, 28 read 3, 5 read 2) and the page is ordered good to bad by that head's expected grade. Seed 1.
why: NEVER EVAL-ELIGIBLE, and the gallery_grade store refuses a batch that claims otherwise. The draw is conditioned on this store's own head twice over - the seats exist because the solve narrowed its pool at p_fine >= 0.184, and the 250 are the LOWEST readings of that column among the ungraded - so no rate read off them is a rate about the world or about the gallery. THE PAGE IS PREFILLED AND SCORE-ORDERED, which is why anchored is true. What this sitting asks is the opposite question to p_fine_correction_20260909's top band: that one hunted false positives at the good end, this one asks whether the head's own least-liked seats are as bad as it says, so the correction it measures is UPWARD and its rate is a ceiling on the head's error at the bottom of a gallery rather than its report card. The prefill is read at the ledger's 640x360 candidate geometry and not on the 1280x720 picture the page serves. refusal is null on every row because every unit here took a seat; seated is true on all 250 for the same reason.

method: 545 rows over 545 distinct locations, cut 2026-09-10 from the tentative record 20260910T025205Z (solve tentative_n1000_20260910T025205Z, n=1000, fine bar 0.184, fine head corrected_auc_ge4_more_seed1). ONE BLOCK, and the selection is a census rather than a sample: of the record's 1,000 seats, 455 carried a manual verdict in this store when the plan was cut and 545 did not, and all 545 were taken. Both joins were run and agreed exactly on all 455 - gallery_grade.render_key against the ledger's own render key, and selected_on.candidate against the seat key - and every key of gallery_tail_20260910's plan was additionally excluded by key, which removed nothing further because that sitting was already ingested. Nothing was dropped: all 545 resolved in the ledger, all 545 sit at distinct locations, and every ledger row named its whole recipe. Against the adopted head these 545 are the record's TOP band, spanning p_fine 0.704563 to 0.999457, which is the complement of gallery_tail_20260910's 0.191093-0.704099. REALIZED over the 545: 12 of the 13 accepted modes (direct_trap_lines absent), all 48 chromatic cells and 12 of 13 hue families; tia 163, smooth 150, stripe 110, threads 46; kinds 391 strange / 154 smooth; 176 rows render through the candidate's own re-baked colormap. The adopted head prefills all 545 of these rows as 4; the averaged column prefills 314 fours, 218 threes and 13 twos, and the two decodes disagree on 231 rows. THE CUT A ROW LANDS IN IS DRAWN AT RANDOM at seed 20260910, independently of its score, its mode, its cell, its leg and its seat, in three equal cuts of 182/182/181 - because the last sitting's three cuts differed by about nine-tenths of a tier on held-out rows with sheet confounded against block, and a cut that is independent of everything else is what makes the next reading of that a reading of the cut. Every row's cut and page position is recorded beside the plan.

method: 200 rows over 200 distinct locations, cut 2026-09-10 as part 4 of augmentation_sweep_20260910. THE POPULATION IS THE SYMMETRIC DIFFERENCE OF TWO n=1000 SEATINGS, both solved through the pool-view door with NO RECORD WRITTEN, over the same 308,885-candidate pool at the live ledger stamp. Column 1 ADOPTED: artifacts/gallery_grade_head/pool_scores.jsonl as it stands, run corrected_auc_ge4_more_seed1. Column 2 BEST-ARM ENSEMBLE: the mean on the PROBABILITY scale of p_ge4 over the three seeds of the sweep's drop_high arm (the shipped recipe with drop_rate 0.2->0.4 and drop_path_rate 0.1->0.2, fitted on all 2,545 graded rows at a fixed 30-epoch horizon with patience above it, each seed taken at its own held-out-CORN-loss minimum). EACH COLUMN GOT ITS OWN BAR at the 27.76% matched fraction and the live 0.184 was never reused: 0.185632 for adopted and 0.188383 for the ensemble, each admitting 11,743 of 42,300. Both solves filled 1,000 with no shortfall and they share only 215 seats, so the symmetric difference is 785 a side. 140 keys were drawn at random from each side at seed 20260910 and cut back to the first 100 a side that sit at distinct locations, one row per location across BOTH sheets of this pair. REALIZED over the 200: 100 adopted-only and 100 ensemble-only, 200 distinct locations, all 48 chromatic cells, 13 modes led by smooth 52 / tia 47 / stripe 41, 56 rows rendering through the candidate's own re-baked colormap. THE PAGE IS THE BLIND GALLERY-GRADE PAGE PLUS ONE LINE: no prefill, a seeded shuffle, no caption and no columns, and the single fact on each card names which column picked that seat. The units are interleaved at random rather than blocked by column, because seats_ingest_20260910 measured a +0.967-tier drift across one afternoon's three cuts and a page that blocked them would confound the comparison with the hour. ⚠ THE TWO SIDES ARE NOT EQUALLY FRESH AND THAT IS NOT AVOIDABLE: the adopted seating reproduces the record 20260910T025205Z whose 1,000 seats were the populations of gallery_tail_20260910 and gallery_top_20260910, so ALL 100 adopted-only units already carry a verdict in this store (59 from gallery_top_20260910, 32 from gallery_tail_20260910, 9 elsewhere) while only 16 of the 100 ensemble-only units do. Excluding graded rows would have emptied the adopted side entirely and there would be no sheet. So the 100 re-grades are taken deliberately and they buy a second reading: the standing verdicts on them were cast on PREFILLED, SCORE-ORDERED pages and these are cast blind on one page in one sitting, which is a within-row measurement of the anchoring and the scale drift that seats_ingest_20260910 could only measure between cuts.
why: NEVER EVAL-ELIGIBLE, and the gallery_grade store refuses a batch that claims otherwise. The population is model-selected three times over - every row cleared the render judge's per-mode bar to be in the pool, every row was then seated by one of two solves, and a row is here only BECAUSE the two columns disagreed about it - so no rate read off these 200 is a rate about the world, about the gallery, or about either column's error. THE CARD NAMES THE COLUMN, so this page is blind in every respect except the one it exists to test, and a labeler who wanted to could grade toward a column; that is why its twin aug_sweep_B_20260910 exists and why the two are read together. It is NOT prefilled and NOT score-ordered, so anchored is false: unlike every sitting since 2026-09-09 this one measures a grade rather than a correction, and its distribution is comparable with n1000_0906_* rather than with gallery_top_20260910. refusal is null on every row and seated is true on all 200, because every unit took a seat in one of the two solves. AND: 100 of the 200 rows are re-grades of rows this store already holds, so a verdict here may be a memory of one cast on 2026-09-10 rather than an independent reading, and the 100 fresh rows on the other side carry no such risk. The A-versus-B comparison inside this page is still one page, one scale and one blind sitting, which is the whole reason the sheet exists; what it is not is 200 independent first impressions. Corrected in place before any row existed, per labeling/registry.refuse_contradiction.

method: 200 rows over 200 distinct locations, cut 2026-09-10 as part 4 of augmentation_sweep_20260910 and the twin of aug_sweep_A_20260910. THE POPULATION IS WHERE THE TWO COLUMNS DISAGREE MOST. The two are those of aug_sweep_A_20260910's registration - the adopted pool_scores.jsonl column, and the probability-scale mean of p_ge4 over the three seeds of the sweep's drop_high arm. Both were read over all 42,300 clearing candidates, each was turned into a percentile within that population, and the rows were ranked by the ABSOLUTE DIFFERENCE OF THE TWO PERCENTILES. Restricted to rows at least one column ADMITS at its own 27.76%-matched bar (0.185632 adopted, 0.188383 ensemble), with every key of aug_sweep_A_20260910 excluded, every key this store already holds excluded by both joins, and one row per location across both sheets. The 200 taken span a percentile gap of 0.7322 to 0.9648 - so the least-disagreeing row here still sits 73 percentiles apart on the two columns. REALIZED over the 200: 200 distinct locations, 42 of the 48 chromatic cells, 10 modes and the mix is NOT the pool's - smooth 125 of 200 against stripe 33 and tia 27, which is what ranking on the disagreement finds rather than anything the draw imposed; 53 rows render through the candidate's own re-baked colormap. THE PAGE IS BLIND, and this is the first sitting since 2026-09-08 that is: no prefill of any kind, a seeded shuffle for an order, no caption, no facts and no columns. Nothing on a card says which column favoured that row or by how much; both readings travel on the row under selected_on, which the page does not render.
why: NEVER EVAL-ELIGIBLE, and the gallery_grade store refuses a batch that claims otherwise. The population is conditioned on both columns twice over - a row is here because at least one column admits it AND because the two disagree about it by more than 73 percentiles - so no rate read off these 200 is a rate about the world, about the gallery, or about either column. What it CAN answer is the one question a disagreement makes answerable: where the two columns part company, which one is right. It is blind and unanchored, so anchored is false and the verdicts here are grades rather than corrections; its scale is comparable with n1000_0906_* and with its twin aug_sweep_A_20260910, and NOT with any prefilled sitting. seated is false on every row: these are pool rows and not seats, and refusal is null because no counterfactual replay named a rule that refused them.
